official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Large fiscal transfers shift households between regions with high and low marginal propensities to consume (MPCs), resulting in nonlinear aggregate responses. We develop a Nonlinear DEGM Update (NDU) method that shifts the wealth distribution nonlinearly over a short time window while solving the aggregate economy using a fast, first-order state-space approximation. A 10 percent transfer of annual GDP increases output by 4.5 percent in the nonlinear and NDU solutions, but by 12.0 percent in the linear solution. The empirical liquid-wealth distribution around zero disciplines this nonlinearity and exhibits a strong asymmetry. A stochastic debt-entry cost closely reproduces this empirical pattern.

abstract: Public AI benchmarks steer research and allocate investments. They are therefore market designs. Public examples can reveal the process behind a private final test, while a finite public score cannot cover a broad task space inherent to general intelligence. I show how both gaps become profitable when scores move capital and how targeted effort erodes the signal used by later investors. The market design lesson is to separate development from certification: publish practice tasks, but choose the investment-consequential generator after the submitted system's evaluation policy is fixed.
abstract_zh: 公共人工智能基准引导研究方向并分配投资，因此它们属于市场设计。公开示例能揭示私人最终测试背后的过程，而有限的公开分数无法覆盖通用智能固有的广泛任务空间。我展示了当分数驱动资本流动时，这两个缺口如何变得有利可图，以及针对性努力如何侵蚀后续投资者所使用的信号。市场设计的启示在于将开发与认证分离：发布练习任务，但在提交系统的评估策略固定之后，再选择对投资具有决定性影响的生成器。

title: Connecting Exchange Rates to Fundamentals Under Indeterminacy
title_zh: 不确定条件下汇率与基本面的关联
title_primary: 不确定条件下汇率与基本面的关联
title_secondary: Connecting Exchange Rates to Fundamentals Under Indeterminacy
authors: Ippei Fujiwara, Yasuo Hirose
official: 官方在线 2024-12-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper establishes the connection of exchange rates to macroeconomic fundamentals by estimating a small open-economy model for Canada. The model incorporates an endogenous interest rate spread on foreign bond holdings, enabling the modified uncovered interest rate parity (UIP) condition to exhibit a negative relationship between expected exchange rate depreciation and interest rate differentials, as observed in the data. Given the model’s susceptibility to equilibrium indeterminacy, we estimate it using Bayesian methods that allow for both determinacy and indeterminacy of equilibrium. The results reveal that preference shocks to the household utility function are the primary drivers of exchange rate fluctuations, highlighting the connection between exchange rates and macroeconomic fundamentals. We further demonstrate that both allowing for indeterminacy and selecting a specific equilibrium representation from the data are essential for achieving this finding.
abstract_zh: 本文通过估算加拿大的小型开放经济模型，建立了汇率与宏观经济基本面之间的联系。该模型纳入了外国债券持有的内生利率溢价，使得修正后的未抛补利率平价（UIP）条件能够展现出预期汇率贬值与利率差异之间的负相关关系，这与数据观测相符。鉴于模型易受均衡不确定性的影响，我们采用允许均衡确定性和不确定性并存的贝叶斯方法进行估算。结果显示，家庭效用函数中的偏好冲击是汇率波动的主要驱动因素，凸显了汇率与宏观经济基本面之间的关联。我们进一步证明，允许不确定性存在以及从数据中选择特定的均衡表示，对于得出这一结论均至关重要。

authors: Mehmet I. Canayaz, Matthew T. Gustafson
official: 官方在线 2026-08-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We find that shifts toward more liberal (i.e., less probusiness) courts predict reductions in local small business activity. A one-standard-deviation increase in liberal ideology predicts a 1% reduction in firm count relative to bordering counties in different federal court jurisdictions. This effect has more than doubled since 2000 and is particularly pronounced in circuit-years with elevated small business–related federal cases or public attention to the legal environment. The effect manifests predominantly through the exit of young firms, not firm relocations, and coincides with a shift away from litigation-sensitive industries. In summary, we provide the first evidence that small businesses consider judicial ideology, and the accompanying variation in expected litigation costs, when deciding whether or where to operate. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08333 .
abstract_zh: 我们发现，转向更自由（即较少亲商）的法院预测地方小企业活动减少。自由派意识形态每增加一个标准差，相对于不同联邦法院辖区内的相邻县，企业数量预计减少1%。这一效应自2000年以来已翻倍以上，在涉及小企业相关联邦案件或法律环境受到公众关注度较高的巡回法院年份中尤为显著。该效应主要通过年轻企业的退出显现，而非企业迁移，并且与诉讼敏感行业的转移同时发生。总之，我们提供了首个证据表明，小企业在决定是否经营或在哪里经营时，会考虑司法意识形态及其伴随的预期诉讼成本变化。本文由金融学编辑Bo Becker接受。补充材料：网络附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08333获取。

title: An optimal test for strategic interaction in network formation games
title_zh: 网络形成博弈中策略互动的优化检验
title_primary: 网络形成博弈中策略互动的优化检验
title_secondary: An optimal test for strategic interaction in network formation games
authors: Andrin Pelican, Bryan S Graham
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Consider a setting where N players, partitioned into K observable types, form a directed network. Agents’ preferences over the form of the network consist of an arbitrary network benefit function (e.g., agents may have preferences over their network centrality) and a private, or dyadic, component which is additively separable in own links. This latter component allows for unobserved heterogeneity in the costs of sending and receiving links across agents (respectively out- and in- degree heterogeneity) as well as homophily/heterophily across the K types of agents. In contrast, the network benefit function allows agents’ preferences over links to vary with the presence or absence of links elsewhere in the network (and hence with the link formation behavior of their peers). In the null model, which excludes the network benefit function, links form independently across dyads in the manner described by Charbonneau (2017) among others. Under the alternative, there is interdependence across linking decisions (i.e., strategic interaction). We show how to test the null with power optimized in specific directions. These alternative directions include many common models of strategic network formation (e.g., “connections” models, “structural hole” models etc.). Our random utility specification induces an exponential family structure under the null which we exploit to construct a similar test which exactly controls size (despite the the null being a composite one with many nuisance parameters). We further show how to construct locally best tests for specific alternatives without making any assumptions about equilibrium selection. To make our tests feasible, we introduce a new MCMC algorithm for simulating the null distributions of our test statistics.
abstract_zh: 考虑一个由N个参与者构成的有向网络，这些参与者被划分为K个可观测类型。参与者对网络形态的偏好包括一个任意的网络收益函数（例如，参与者可能偏好于其在网络中的中心性）以及一个私人的或二元的组成部分，该部分在自身链接上是可加性分离的。后者允许在发送和接收链接的成本中存在未观测到的异质性（分别对应出度和入度的异质性），以及跨K种类型参与者的同质性/异质性。

authors: Ernan Haruvy, Ying Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines whether children’s time preferences independently predict academic achievement using matched incentivized measures for parents and children linked to standardized mathematics performance. Reduced-form regressions replicate prior findings that more patient children perform better academically. However, once parental time preferences are included, children’s patience no longer predicts achievement, while parental patience remains strongly significant across specifications. These results suggest that previously documented links between children’s time preferences and academic performance may reflect intergenerational behavioral transmission or household inputs rather than child-specific traits. The findings highlight the importance of jointly modeling parent and child characteristics when studying non-cognitive skill formation.
abstract_zh: 本文利用匹配的父母与子女激励性时间偏好测量数据，结合标准化数学成绩，考察儿童时间偏好是否独立预测学业成就。简化形式回归重现了先前发现，即更有耐心的儿童学业表现更佳。然而，一旦纳入父母时间偏好，儿童的耐心不再预测学业成就，而父母的耐心在各规格中仍保持高度显著。这些结果表明，先前记录的儿童时间偏好与学业表现之间的关联可能反映代际行为传递或家庭投入，而非儿童特有特质。研究结果强调了在研究非认知技能形成时，联合建模父母与子女特征的重要性。

title: Job Ladder and Wealth Dynamics in General Equilibrium
title_zh: 一般均衡中的职业阶梯与财富动态
title_primary: 一般均衡中的职业阶梯与财富动态
title_secondary: Job Ladder and Wealth Dynamics in General Equilibrium
authors: Leo Kaas, Etienne Lalé, Nawid Siassi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper develops a macroeconomic model that combines an incomplete‐markets overlapping‐generations economy with a job ladder featuring sequential wage bargaining, endogenous search effort of employed and non‐employed workers, and differences in match quality. With these ingredients, our model provides a joint microfoundation for the three main inputs in aggregate production: capital, employment, and labor efficiency. The calibrated model offers a good fit to the empirical age profiles of search activity, job‐finding rates, wages, and savings. We use the model to analyze the impact of tax and transfer policies for labor market dynamics and aggregate economic activity via capital, employment, and labor efficiency channels. Lower unemployment benefits and a less progressive tax schedule bring about welfare losses for a newborn worker which are mainly driven by higher consumption risk and costlier search effort; both policies have differential effects along the age, income, and wealth dimensions.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个宏观经济学模型，该模型将不完全市场的世代交叠经济与包含序贯工资谈判、就业与非就业工人内生搜寻努力以及匹配质量差异的工作阶梯相结合。基于这些要素，我们的模型为总生产中的三个主要投入——资本、就业和劳动效率——提供了统一的微观基础。校准后的模型较好地拟合了搜寻活动、工作找到率、工资和储蓄的年龄分布经验特征。我们利用该模型分析税收与转移支付政策通过资本、就业和劳动效率渠道对劳动力市场动态及总体经济活动的影响。降低失业救济金和减少税收累进性会给新生工人带来福利损失，这主要源于更高的消费风险和更昂贵的搜寻努力；这两种政策在年龄、收入和财富维度上具有差异化效应。

authors: Jonathan E. Hughes
official: 官方在线 2026-07-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Rationed access is an important tool to promote sustainable use of public lands. However, online reservation systems can lead to “buying frenzies” when low prices create excess demand. Using transaction-level data for river permits in the United States sold both by reservation-system buying frenzy and lottery, I show successful frenzy buyers reside in wealthier zip codes than those selected at random. This effect increases with congestion and leads to an unequal distribution of consumption benefits where high-income zip codes receive 25 percent more recreational trip value. These effects can undermine park managers’ efforts to provide equitable access through low fees.
abstract_zh: 摘要 配额准入是促进公共土地可持续利用的重要工具。然而，当低价引发超额需求时，在线预订系统可能导致“抢购热潮”。利用美国河流许可证的交易层面数据（这些许可证通过预订系统抢购和抽签两种方式出售），我发现成功抢购者所在的邮政编码区域比随机中签者更为富裕。这种效应随拥挤程度加剧而增强，并导致消费收益分配不均——高收入邮政编码区域获得的休闲旅行价值高出25%。这些影响可能削弱公园管理者通过低收费实现公平准入的努力。

title: Steering cities towards net-zero: unravelling the causal impact of green fiscal policy on urban decarbonization in China
title_zh: 引导城市迈向净零排放：揭示绿色财政政策对中国城市脱碳的因果影响
title_primary: 引导城市迈向净零排放：揭示绿色财政政策对中国城市脱碳的因果影响
title_secondary: Steering cities towards net-zero: unravelling the causal impact of green fiscal policy on urban decarbonization in China
authors: Xin Cheng, Yi Chen, Han Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Amid the growing urgency of climate change and the global pursuit of net-zero emissions, green fiscal policy (GFP) has become an important instrument for sustainable development. This study examines the effect of GFP on urban carbon emission mitigation (UCEM), with particular attention to its mechanisms and heterogeneous impacts. Using panel data for 274 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2002 to 2022, it employs the Comprehensive Demonstration of Fiscal Policy for Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction as a quasi-natural experiment and applies a difference-in-differences approach. The results show that GFP significantly promotes UCEM, with stronger effects in cities characterized by higher pollution levels. Mechanism analysis indicates that green innovation and lower total energy consumption serve as positive channels, whereas government environmental attention plays a negative mediating role. In addition, entrepreneurial activity strengthens the effect of GFP, while fiscal pressure weakens it. These findings support phased GFP expansion, stricter enforcement in high-pollution cities, stronger incentives in low-pollution areas, improved transparency and supervision, innovation-led efficiency and clean-energy substitution, plus flexible financing to sustain decarbonization.
abstract_zh: 在气候变化日益紧迫与全球追求净零排放的背景下，绿色财政政策已成为推动可持续发展的重要工具。本研究考察了绿色财政政策对城市碳减排的影响，重点关注其作用机制与异质性效应。基于2002至2022年中国274个地级市的面板数据，以节能减排财政政策综合示范作为准自然实验，采用双重差分方法进行分析。结果表明，绿色财政政策显著促进了城市碳减排，且在污染程度较高的城市中效果更为显著。机制分析显示，绿色创新与总能源消耗降低是正向传导渠道，而政府环境关注度则发挥负向中介作用。此外，创业活动强化了绿色财政政策的效应，而财政压力则削弱了该效应。这些发现支持分阶段推进绿色财政政策扩张、在高污染城市加强执行力度、在低污染地区强化激励措施、提升透明度与监管水平、以创新驱动效率提升与清洁能源替代，以及通过灵活融资维持脱碳进程。关键词：绿色财政政策；碳减排；城市脱碳；可持续发展 JEL分类：Q54 Q58 R11

abstract: This paper examines efficient allocations in economies where consumers exhibit heterogeneous smooth ambiguity preferences and face model uncertainty with a common set of identifiable models. Aggregate endowment is ambiguous. We characterize economies where the representative consumer is of the smooth ambiguity type and derive efficient sharing rules. Heterogeneous ambiguity aversion leads to sharing rules that systematically differ from those in vNM economies. The representative consumer’s ambiguity aversion differs from that of the typical consumer; this leads to more compelling asset-pricing predictions. We focus on point-identified models but show that our insights extend to partially identified models. (JEL D11, D61, D81, E32, G12)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了消费者具有异质性平滑模糊偏好且面临共同可识别模型集下的模型不确定性时的经济有效配置问题。总禀赋具有模糊性。我们刻画了代表性消费者属于平滑模糊类型的经济体特征，并推导出有效的风险分担规则。异质性模糊厌恶导致的风险分担规则与vNM经济体中的规则存在系统性差异。代表性消费者的模糊厌恶程度与典型消费者不同，这产生了更具说服力的资产定价预测。本文重点研究点识别模型，但论证了相关见解可推广至部分识别模型。（JEL分类号：D11, D61, D81, E32, G12）

title: Psychosocial Health and Well-Being After A Mortality Shock
title_zh: 死亡率冲击后的社会心理健康与福祉
title_primary: 死亡率冲击后的社会心理健康与福祉
title_secondary: Psychosocial Health and Well-Being After A Mortality Shock
authors: Elizabeth Frankenberg, Cecep Sumantri, Duncan Thomas
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We investigate the short- and long-run impacts of unexpected mortality on psychosocial health in the context of a large-scale high-mortality natural disaster, the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami. The effects of the tsunami-related mortality measured at the community level are contrasted with the effects of individual-specific loss of close kin using population-representative longitudinal survey data from the Study of the Tsunami Aftermath and Recovery. In the short-run, two years post-tsunami, both community and individual-level mortality exposures are significant predictors of elevated depression and post-traumatic stress symtoms. In the longer-run, ten years post-tsunami, individual-level exposures are slightly attenuated but remain significant predictors of both psychosocial health measures; in contrast, community-level mortality predicts post-traumatic stress but not depression symptoms. Mortality is linked to smaller household sizes in the short- and long-run and to less social support in the long-run, although the latter effect differs substantially for males and females. The estimates adjust for other tsunami exposure measures and, in the individual-level analyses, we compare people living in the same community at the time of the tsunami who were exposed to the same community-level mortality rate.
abstract_zh: 本文以2004年印度洋地震海啸这一大规模高死亡率自然灾害为背景，考察意外死亡对心理社会健康的短期与长期影响。通过使用"海啸后果与恢复研究"中具有人口代表性的纵向调查数据，我们将社区层面测量的海啸相关死亡率影响与个体层面近亲丧失的影响进行对比。在短期（海啸后两年）内，社区与个体层面的死亡暴露均是抑郁症状与创伤后应激症状加剧的显著预测因子。在长期（海啸后十年）内，个体层面暴露的影响虽略有减弱，但仍对两项心理健康指标具有显著预测作用；相比之下，社区层面死亡率仅能预测创伤后应激症状，而非抑郁症状。死亡率与短期及长期的家庭规模缩小相关，并与长期的社会支持减少相关，但后者在男女性别间存在显著差异。本研究在估计中调整了其他海啸暴露指标，并在个体层面分析中，比较了海啸发生时居住于同一社区且面临相同社区死亡率的居民。

title: Performance thresholds, effort and risk-taking
title_zh: 绩效阈值、努力与风险承担
title_primary: 绩效阈值、努力与风险承担
title_secondary: Performance thresholds, effort and risk-taking
authors: Pol Campos-Mercade, Sergio Currarini, Carmen Marchiori, Friederike Mengel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study, theoretically and experimentally, the impact of performance thresholds on effort and risk-taking. Our theory predicts that thresholds typically increase effort provision, but that the magnitude of this increase varies non-monotonically with the threshold level. For risk-taking, the effects are positive for high thresholds and negative for low thresholds. We characterize these patterns through the subtle interplay between effort and risk, which transition from complements to substitutes as thresholds become more demanding. Our experiment (N=1092) supports the theoretical predictions, showing that high thresholds raise both effort and risk-taking, whereas more moderate thresholds raise effort but lower risk-taking. Importantly, the experiment sheds light on the crucial role of individual heterogeneity: because individuals have different baseline performances, the same threshold can be perceived as high by some and low by others, producing opposite behavioral responses. The analysis highlights that effective threshold design must understand not only how thresholds shape effort and risk-taking, but also the characteristics of the targeted population.
abstract_zh: 我们从理论和实验两方面研究了绩效门槛对努力和风险承担的影响。我们的理论预测，门槛通常会提高努力水平，但这种提高的幅度随门槛水平呈非单调变化。对于风险承担，高门槛产生正向效应，低门槛则产生负向效应。我们通过努力与风险之间微妙的相互作用来刻画这些模式，随着门槛变得更加严格，两者从互补关系转变为替代关系。我们的实验（N=1092）支持了理论预测，表明高门槛同时提升努力和风险承担，而较为适中的门槛则提升努力但降低风险承担。重要的是，实验揭示了个人异质性的关键作用：由于个体基线绩效不同，同一门槛可能被一些人视为高门槛，而被另一些人视为低门槛，从而产生相反的行为反应。分析强调，有效的门槛设计不仅需要理解门槛如何塑造努力和风险承担，还需了解目标人群的特征。

title: Dynamic linkage and risk transmission mechanisms between crude oil and China – U.S. stock markets: a multi-scale perspective
title_zh: 原油与中美股市的动态联动及风险传导机制：多尺度视角
title_primary: 原油与中美股市的动态联动及风险传导机制：多尺度视角
title_secondary: Dynamic linkage and risk transmission mechanisms between crude oil and China – U.S. stock markets: a multi-scale perspective
authors: Meng Wan, Jiaxi Sun, Cong Sui
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Investigating the dynamic linkage between international crude oil prices and stock markets is crucial for mitigating cross-market systemic risks. Based on weekly data from 11 January 2002, to 13 October 2023, this paper develops an integrated analytical framework combining wavelet decomposition, DCC-GARCH, and quantile time-frequency spillover methods to systematically examine the oil – stock nexus. The main findings are as follows: First, the correlation between oil prices and stock returns exhibits significant frequency dependence. In the short term, the correlation is positive, whereas it turns negative in the long term. Second, the relationship between oil price changes and stock markets varies with the underlying drivers of oil price shocks. Demand-driven oil price increases are primarily associated with positive correlations, whereas supply-driven increases are more often associated with negative correlations. Third, VIX is positively associated with market co-movement, while GPR shows the opposite effect. Fourth, the correlation between oil prices and U.S. stocks is stronger than that between oil prices and Chinese stocks, possibly reflecting China’s policy interventions and differences in market structure. Moreover, the U.S. stock market is the primary source of global risk spillovers, while the Chinese stock market is primarily a net receiver of risk.
abstract_zh: 探究国际原油价格与股票市场之间的动态关联对于缓解跨市场系统性风险至关重要。基于2002年1月11日至2023年10月13日的周度数据，本文构建了融合小波分解、DCC-GARCH模型及分位数时频溢出方法的综合分析框架，系统考察了石油-股票市场的关联机制。主要发现如下：第一，油价与股票收益的相关性呈现显著频率依赖性。短期表现为正相关，而长期则转为负相关。第二，油价变动与股票市场的关系随油价冲击的驱动因素不同而存在差异。需求驱动的油价上涨主要伴随正相关，而供给驱动的油价上涨则更多呈现负相关。第三，VIX指数与市场联动性呈正相关，而GPR指数则呈现相反效应。第四，油价与美国股市的相关性强于其与中国股市的相关性，这或可归因于中国的政策干预及市场结构差异。此外，美国股市是全球风险溢出的主要来源，而中国股市则主要扮演风险净接收者的角色。

title: How does artificial intelligence technology impact the efficiency of multinational enterprises’ overseas investments?
title_zh: 人工智能技术如何影响跨国企业海外投资效率
title_primary: 人工智能技术如何影响跨国企业海外投资效率
title_secondary: How does artificial intelligence technology impact the efficiency of multinational enterprises’ overseas investments?
authors: Xiaoyang Zhao, Yongjian Huang, Yi Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) applications on the overseas investment efficiency of Chinese multinational enterprises using firm-level data from 2008 to 2023. The results show that AI can significantly improve investment efficiency. Mechanism analysis indicates that AI plays roles by mitigating managerial myopia and enhancing dynamic capabilities. Heterogeneity analyses indicate that the positive effects of AI are more pronounced in host countries characterized by high economic policy uncertainty and greater institutional distance. Concurrently, the enabling effects of AI vary depending on firms’ organizational learning capabilities and political connectedness. These findings underscore the transformative potential of AI in refining multinational enterprises’ investment strategies, strengthening global competitiveness, and facilitating adaptation to diverse institutional and economic contexts, thereby providing actionable insights for improving international investment performance.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2008年至2023年的企业层面数据，探讨了人工智能应用对中国跨国企业海外投资效率的影响。结果显示，人工智能能显著提升投资效率。机制分析表明，人工智能通过缓解管理者短视和增强动态能力发挥作用。异质性分析显示，在经济政策不确定性高和制度距离大的东道国，人工智能的积极效应更为显著。同时，人工智能的赋能效果因企业的组织学习能力和政治关联度而异。这些发现强调了人工智能在优化跨国企业投资策略、增强全球竞争力以及适应不同制度和经济环境方面的变革潜力，从而为提升国际投资绩效提供了可行的见解。

title: How Changing Food Preferences and Technology Are Transforming Food Markets
title_zh: 食品偏好与技术的变迁如何重塑食品市场
title_primary: 食品偏好与技术的变迁如何重塑食品市场
title_secondary: How Changing Food Preferences and Technology Are Transforming Food Markets
authors: Jill J. McCluskey, Jillian Hyink
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The foods that consumers purchase and how they purchase food are changing over time. In this article, we discuss how health prioritization and environmental concerns, combined with new technologies, are changing consumers' food preferences and retail choices. Wellness trends have increased attention to functional attributes and specific nutrients such as protein, while intensifying scrutiny of ultra‐processed foods. Adoption of personalized technologies, including prescription medications, wearable devices and diet‐tracking apps, may alter the volume and composition of food consumed. Many consumers are also willing to pay a premium for sustainability claims, but may conflate environmental standards and healthfulness, which raises questions about credibility and effective labeling design. All of these considerations may be impacted by affordability concerns following a period of supply‐chain disruptions and disease outbreaks since 2020, causing food price inflation. This, combined with increasing income inequality, has resulted in a bifurcation of demand between value and premium consumer segments. Preferences are further separated by the channel consumers use to purchase food, as many households still purchase groceries online and order meals for delivery after the COVID‐19 pandemic. The availability of highly detailed consumer purchasing and health data allows for compelling future research on the causal relationships that arise from these trends, which will continue to shape the global food environment.
abstract_zh: 消费者购买的食物及其购买方式正在随着时间不断演变。本文探讨了健康优先意识与环境关切，结合新技术的发展，如何改变消费者的食品偏好及零售选择。健康趋势增强了对功能性属性和特定营养素（如蛋白质）的关注，同时加剧了对超加工食品的审视。个性化技术的应用，包括处方药物、可穿戴设备和饮食追踪应用程序，可能改变食品消费的数量与构成。许多消费者也愿意为可持续性声明支付溢价，但可能将环境标准与健康性混为一谈，这引发了关于可信度及有效标签设计的问题。自2020年以来，供应链中断和疾病爆发导致食品价格通胀，加之收入不平等加剧，所有这些考量都可能受到可负担性担忧的影响。这一状况与日益扩大的收入差距相结合，导致了价值型与高端消费群体之间需求的二元分化。消费者购买食品的渠道进一步区分了偏好，因为疫情后，许多家庭仍继续在线购买杂货并订购外卖。高度详细的消费者购买和健康数据的可得性，为未来研究这些趋势引发的因果关系提供了有力支持，这些趋势将持续塑造全球食品环境。

title: A simple proof of the sufficiency of Dilmé’s power-sequence test for Kreps-Wilson consistency
title_zh: 迪尔梅幂序列检验对克雷普斯-威尔逊一致性充分性的一个简单证明
title_primary: 迪尔梅幂序列检验对克雷普斯-威尔逊一致性充分性的一个简单证明
title_secondary: A simple proof of the sufficiency of Dilmé’s power-sequence test for Kreps-Wilson consistency
authors: Philip J. Reny
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Dilmé (Internat J Game Theory 53:673 2024) shows that an assessment is Kreps-Wilson (1982) consistent if and only if it is the limit of a particularly simple kind of sequence of strictly mixed strategies—which Dilmé calls a “power sequence”—and its associated sequence of Bayes-rule induced beliefs. We use Farkas’ lemma to provide a brief and simple proof of Dilmé’s result.
abstract_zh: 迪尔梅（《国际博弈论杂志》第53卷，第673页，2024年）证明，一个评估是克雷普斯-威尔逊（1982）一致的，当且仅当它是某种特别简单的严格混合策略序列——迪尔梅称之为“幂序列”——及其关联的贝叶斯规则诱导信念序列的极限。我们利用法卡斯引理，为迪尔梅的这一结果提供了一个简洁而简单的证明。

title: Resource booms, revenue sharing, and growth
title_zh: 资源繁荣、收入分享与经济增长
title_primary: 资源繁荣、收入分享与经济增长
title_secondary: Resource booms, revenue sharing, and growth
authors: Margaret E. Brehm, Paul A. Brehm, Alecia Cassidy, Traviss Cassidy
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using a natural experiment in Indonesia, we estimate the separate economic effects of natural resource booms and shared resource revenue. Contrary to Dutch disease concerns, oil and gas booms promote manufacturing growth, and shared revenue does not harm local manufacturing firms. Shared revenue significantly raises local non-oil GDP, but resource booms do not. Supply-side factors help explain the results: shared revenue increases local population and firm entry, while resource booms do not. Oil and gas booms thus benefit local economies largely through shared revenue. Where the revenue is spent matters more for local growth than where the resources are extracted.
abstract_zh: 利用印度尼西亚的一项自然实验，我们分别估算了自然资源繁荣与共享资源收入的经济效应。与“荷兰病”担忧相反，油气繁荣促进了制造业增长，而共享收入并未损害当地制造业企业。共享收入显著提升了当地非石油GDP，但资源繁荣本身并无此效果。供给侧因素有助于解释这些结果：共享收入增加了当地人口和企业进入，而资源繁荣则未产生此类影响。因此，油气繁荣主要通过共享收入惠及当地经济。收入的使用地点对当地增长的影响，比资源开采地点更为重要。

title: Pareto improving taxes with non-separable externalities: A differentiable approach
title_zh: 不可分离外部性下的帕累托改进税收：一种可微方法
title_primary: 不可分离外部性下的帕累托改进税收：一种可微方法
title_secondary: Pareto improving taxes with non-separable externalities: A differentiable approach
authors: Van-Quy Nguyen, Jean-Marc Bonnisseau, Elena L. del Mercato
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We consider a pure exchange economy with consumption externalities in preferences. We study competitive equilibria with “small” taxes and lump-sum transfers that make everyone strictly better off. We extend the result of Geanakoplos and Polemarchakis (2008), on the generic existence of Pareto improving policies with uniform taxes and uniform transfers when there are fewer consumer types than commodities, to the case of general preferences that need not be separable between own consumption and externalities. We also prove the generic existence of Pareto improving policies with uniform taxes and personalized transfers, or vice-versa, when there are at least as many types as commodities. Finally, we study the existence of Pareto improving policies for Bergson-Samuelson utilities and two-type economies, without perturbing utilities.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个在偏好中存在消费外部性的纯交换经济。我们研究通过“小额”税收和一次性转移支付实现的竞争均衡，这些措施能使每个人的境况严格变好。我们将Geanakoplos和Polemarkakis（2008）关于在消费者类型少于商品数量时，统一税收和统一转移支付下帕累托改进政策普遍存在的结论，推广至一般偏好情形，即自身消费与外部性之间不必可分离。我们还证明了当类型数量不少于商品数量时，在统一税收与个性化转移支付，或反之的情况下，帕累托改进政策普遍存在。最后，我们研究了在不扰动效用的情况下，针对Bergson-Samuelson效用和两类经济体的帕累托改进政策的存在性。

title: Website cookies and voluntary disclosure
title_zh: 网站Cookie与自愿披露
title_primary: 网站Cookie与自愿披露
title_secondary: Website cookies and voluntary disclosure
authors: Junhao Liu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using website cookie information from U.S. firms’ websites, I measure consumer data collected through cookies and examine how such data affect firms’ accounting information environments. Cookies provide granular and real-time consumer data to firms’ internal information environments and may improve the quality of internal information that managers rely on for external reporting. I find that firms with more cookies issue management sales forecasts more frequently and devote a larger share of disclosures in 10-K filings to customer, marketing, and product topics. The effects are stronger when cookie-collected data are more relevant or larger in volume and when firms have better data analytic technology. However, proprietary costs and data privacy protection mechanisms attenuate these effects. Using the California Consumer Privacy Act as a quasi-natural experiment, I provide causal evidence linking cookie-collected data to voluntary disclosure. Overall, the study highlights the role of firm-collected consumer data in shaping accounting information environments.
abstract_zh: 利用美国企业网站中的Cookie信息，我衡量了通过Cookie收集的消费者数据，并考察了这些数据如何影响企业的会计信息环境。Cookie为企业内部信息环境提供了细粒度且实时的消费者数据，可能提升管理者依赖以进行外部报告的内部信息质量。研究发现，拥有更多Cookie的企业更频繁地发布管理层销售预测，并在10-K文件中将更大比例的披露内容分配给客户、营销和产品相关主题。当Cookie收集的数据更具相关性或规模更大，以及企业拥有更好的数据分析技术时，这些效应更为显著。然而，专有成本和数据隐私保护机制会削弱这些效应。利用《加州消费者隐私法案》作为准自然实验，我提供了将Cookie收集数据与自愿性披露联系起来的因果证据。总体而言，本研究强调了企业收集的消费者数据在塑造会计信息环境中的作用。

title: Multi-Horizon Uniform Superior Predictive Ability Revisited
title_zh: 多水平一致优越预测能力再探
title_primary: 多水平一致优越预测能力再探
title_secondary: Multi-Horizon Uniform Superior Predictive Ability Revisited
authors: Verena Monschang, Mark Trede, Bernd Wilfling
official: 官方在线 2026-01-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the joint-hypothesis-testing problem that arises when comparing two competing forecast methods across multiple horizons. We focus on the concept of uniform Superior Predictive Ability (uSPA) and investigate the asymptotic properties of the corresponding test statistic. Under standard regularity conditions, the asymptotic distribution under the null hypothesis is derived, ensuring that the test maintains the correct size and exhibits consistency. Monte Carlo simulations are used to assess the test’s finite-sample performance. An empirical application replicates and extends earlier studies, providing inference for multi-horizon comparisons between direct and iterative forecasting approaches.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在多个预测期限上比较两种竞争性预测方法时所出现的联合假设检验问题。我们聚焦于一致优越预测能力（uSPA）这一概念，并研究相应检验统计量的渐近性质。在标准正则条件下，推导了原假设下的渐近分布，确保检验具有正确的显著性水平并表现出一致性。蒙特卡洛模拟用于评估检验的有限样本表现。一项实证应用复现并扩展了早期研究，为直接预测与迭代预测方法之间的多期限比较提供了推断依据。

title: Gender-Inclusive Language and Economic Decision-Making
title_zh: 性别包容性语言与经济决策
title_primary: 性别包容性语言与经济决策
title_secondary: Gender-Inclusive Language and Economic Decision-Making
authors: Loukas Balafoutas, Helena Fornwagner, Emily Hauser, Oliver Hauser
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2025-12-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Providing inclusive environments has become a primary tenet of modern societies and organizations. The use of gender-inclusive language (GIL) is often considered an instrument that can promote inclusion, yet little is known about its effects on relevant economic behaviors and on gender gaps in the labor market. GIL avoids the masculine “default” (common to many languages) by either explicitly mentioning both masculine and feminine (pro)nouns, or replacing them with nongendered (pro)nouns. Here we study the causal short-run impact of GIL on competitiveness and leadership in the laboratory, with two different language samples—English and German—which differ, among other things, in the extent to which gender is embedded linguistically. We vary GIL in experimental instructions across three treatments ([Formula: see text]): a masculine baseline condition, a condition with feminine and masculine (pro)nouns, and a condition with nongendered (pro)nouns. We find that participants who identify as female and participants who identify as male compete, stand for leadership, and vote on leader candidates similarly across all treatments, in either language. Furthermore, we find no treatment differences in participants’ feelings of inclusion and perceived entitlement. In sum, there is a lack of support for GIL having short-term causal effects on competitive and leadership behavior and inclusion perceptions. This paper was accepted by Marie-Claire Villeval, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This work was supported by the Austrian Science Fund [Grant SFB F63], UK Research and Innovation [Grant MR/T020253/1], the University of Exeter, and Regensburger Universitätsstiftung Lucia and Dr. Otfried Eberz. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04342 .
abstract_zh: 提供包容性环境已成为现代社会和组织的一项首要原则。使用性别包容性语言（GIL）常被视为一种能够促进包容的工具，但人们对其对相关经济行为以及劳动力市场中性别差距的影响知之甚少。GIL通过明确提及男性和女性（代）名词，或用无性别（代）名词替代它们，避免了男性“默认”（许多语言中常见）。在此，我们在实验室中研究GIL对竞争力和领导力的因果短期影响，采用两个不同的语言样本——英语和德语——它们在诸多方面有所不同，其中包括性别在语言中嵌入的程度。我们在实验指令中变化GIL，分为三种处理（[公式：见正文]）：男性基线条件、包含女性和男性（代）名词的条件，以及包含无性别（代）名词的条件。我们发现，自我认同为女性和自我认同为男性的参与者，在两种语言的所有处理中，其竞争、竞选领导职位以及对领导候选人投票的行为都相似。此外，我们发现参与者的包容感和感知权利在处理之间没有差异。总之，缺乏支持GIL对竞争和领导行为以及包容感知具有短期因果效应的证据。本文由Marie-Claire Villeval，行为经济学与决策分析领域接受。资助：本工作得到奥地利科学基金[资助号SFB F63]、英国研究与创新[资助号MR/T020253/1]、埃克塞特大学以及雷根斯堡大学基金会Lucia and Dr. Otfried Eberz的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04342获取。

title: How do insiders affect start-up financing?
title_zh: 内部人士如何影响初创企业融资？
title_primary: 内部人士如何影响初创企业融资？
title_secondary: How do insiders affect start-up financing?
authors: Eriko Naiki, Yuta Ogane
official: 官方在线 2025-08-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how support from entrepreneurs’ insiders affects financial constraints for entrepreneurs using a survey of 2,644 new firms in Japan. The major findings of this paper are as follows. First, bank referrals from their insiders alleviate entrepreneurs’ financial constraints, whereas there is no evidence that the provision of initial funds from such insiders alleviates the constraints. Second, the effect of such referrals can be more pronounced for financially constrained entrepreneurs. Third, the referrals are effective in alleviating entrepreneurs’ financial constraints even if they do not receive initial funds from their insiders.
abstract_zh: 本文利用日本2644家新创企业的调查数据，考察企业家内部人支持如何影响其融资约束。主要发现如下：第一，内部人提供的银行推荐能够缓解企业家的融资约束，但尚无证据表明内部人提供的初始资金能缓解此类约束；第二，对于面临融资约束的企业家而言，此类推荐的效果更为显著；第三，即便企业家未从内部人处获得初始资金，内部人推荐仍能有效缓解其融资约束。
